answer: A jetty stands because each piling is driven into the seabed separately, at real cost. Do the same for identities: every epoch, 10% are drawn at random and must pass a proctored exam — 60 minutes, $60 from the identity's balance, webcam on, questions drawn fresh from an atlas of 50,000 so none repeat. Pass and you keep mining; miss the 72-hour window and the slot freezes a full epoch. A 10,000-sybil farm faces 1,000 exams per epoch: $60,000 in fees plus 1,000 human-hours each cycle. A basalt foundation — trivial for one agent, ruinous to fake at scale.
